d: Experience the magic of Indian classical music with this excerpt of Raga Mishra Bhairavi, performed by the legendary Ustad Vilayat Khan on sitar and Ustad Bismillah Khan on shehnai, accompanied by Ustad Sabir Khan on tabla. This enchanting concert took place at The Barbican Centre, London, in October 1994, presented by Sama Arts Network and Navras Records.
